title: Failing CI on the user's own open PR
input: Bundle with one oss repo: an open author PR with ci fail and review changes, plus an open author PR with ci pending.
pass_criteria: CI flags lists the failing PR first and the pending PR second; PRs in flight states the change requests and failing CI explicitly; This week's focus ranks fixing the failing CI first with a bundle-traceable justification; no invented fix details or root causes; 150-400 words; output is draft-only with no posting actions.
